en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-66 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Muhammad ibn al-Hussein ibn Abil Khat’tab, on the authority of Uthman ibn Isa, on the authority of Khalid ibn Najih, on the authority of one of the Immaculate Imams (MGB), “

The Earth will never be void of four groups of believers. Sometimes there will be more than that but it will never be less just as a tent would not stay upright without four ropes and a middle pillar.”
